cards.card_text: Zipporah grabs a flint knife, circumcises her son and touches the foreskin to Moses' feet.
cards.verse_text: But Zipporah took a flint knife, cut off her son’s foreskin, and touched it to Moses’ feet.
cards.snippet: But Zipporah took a flint knife, cut off her son’s foreskin, and touched it to Moses’ feet.

cards.card_text: The servants report back, and Saul names his price: “The king desires no other dowry but a hundred Philistine foreskins as revenge on his enemies.” But Saul intends to cause David's death at the hands of the Philistines.
cards.verse_text: Saul replied, “Say to David, ‘The king desires no other dowry but a hundred Philistine foreskins as revenge on his enemies.’” But Saul intended to cause David’s death at the hands of the Philistines.
cards.snippet: …to David, ‘The king desires no other dowry but a hundred Philistine foreskins as revenge on his enemies.’” But Saul intended to cause David’s death…
